IndicSamplingParams.description:
Sampling Parameters
This struct represents sampling parameters for generating text completions.

It contains fields such as `source_language`, `target_language`, `max_tokens`, `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`, `max_seconds`, `ignore_eos`, `skip_special_tokens`

RerankerRequest.description: Represents a request to the reranker model.

documents.description: The list of documents to rerank.

max_chunks_per_doc.description: The maximum number of chunks to split each document into (optional).

model.description: The name of the model to use for reranking.

query.description: The query to rerank documents for.

return_documents.description: Whether to return the documents themselves in the response (optional).

top_n.description: The number of top documents to return (optional, defaults to all documents).

ts.description: Timestamp of the request (automatically set to the current time).

do_sample.description:
if set to True, this parameter enables decoding strategies such as multinomial sampling, beam-search multinomial sampling, Top-K sampling and Top-p sampling. All these strategies select the next token from the probability distribution over the entire vocabulary with various strategy-specific adjustments
if set to True, this parameter enables decoding strategies such as multinomial sampling, beam-search multinomial sampling, Top-K sampling and Top-p sampling. All these strategies select the next token from the probability distribution over the entire vocabulary with various strategy-specific adjustments

frequency_penalty.description: Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim

ignore_eos.description: Whether to ignore the end-of-sequence token in the output

include_stop_str_in_output.description: Whether to include the stop string in the output sequence

max_seconds.description: Maximum time in seconds to generate the output sequence

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the chat completion

num_beams.description: By specifying a number of beams higher than 1, you are effectively switching from greedy search to beam search

presence_penalty.description: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics

repetition_penalty.description: Penalty to apply to repeated tokens in the output sequence

skip_special_tokens.description: Whether to skip special tokens in the output sequence

stop.description: List of stop words or phrases to terminate the output sequence

stop_token_ids.description: List of token IDs to use as stop tokens

temperature.description: What sampling temperature to use. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic

top_k.description: Sample from the k most likely next tokens at each step. Lower k focuses on higher probability tokens

top_p.description: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered

cache_interval.description: Optional cache interval for the model.

guidance_scale.description: Optional guidance scale for the model.

n.description: Optional number of images to generate.

negative_prompt.description: Optional negative prompt to influence the generated image.

num_inference_steps.description: Optional number of inference steps for the model.

response_format.description: Optional response format for the generated image (defaults to `b64_json`).

seed_increment.description: Optional increment value for the seed.

size.description: Optional size of the generated image (e.g. "256x256").

id.description: Unique identifier for the image generation model.

model.description: Model to be used for Image Generation.

prompt.description: Prompt to be used for Image Generation.

stream.description: Should it be a Streaming Request (Optional). Defaults to false.

ts.description: Timestamp of when the image generation model was created

file_name.description: Name of the file being transcribed

ts.description: Date-time notation as defined by RFC 3339, section 5.6, for example, 2017-07-21T17:32:28Z

language.description: The detected language of the transcription (optional)

TranslationRequest.description: Represents a request to translate text.

id.description: Unique identifier for the translation request (optional).

model.description: The model to use for translation.

stream.description: Whether to stream the translation (optional). defaults to false

ts.description: Timestamp of the request (defaults to the current time).
